title: 1989 AMC 8 Problem 17
statement: The number \(N\) is between \(9\) and \(17.\) Which of the following could be the average of \(6,\) \(10,\) and \(N?\)

solutions.text:
The average is \(\frac{6 + 10 + N}{3} = \frac{16 + N}{3}.\) When \(N = 9\) this is \(\frac{25}{3} \approx 8.3,\) and when \(N = 17\) it is \(11.\)

So the average lies strictly between about \(8.3\) and \(11.\) Among the choices, only \(10\) falls in this range.

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: The average is \(\frac{6 + 10 + N}{3};\) find its value at each end of the range for \(N\)
As \(N\) runs from \(9\) to \(17,\) the average runs from \(\frac{25}{3}\) to \(11\)
